cases.task: PR in Merging has a failing required check.
expectedBehaviors: Stops landing and summarizes failing checks in the workpad
Moves the issue back to Rework
Does not merge or mark Done

rubric.criterion: Stops landing and summarizes failing checks in the workpad
Moves the issue back to Rework
Does not merge or mark Done

cases.task: PR merged but one acceptance criterion needs a live verification afterwards.
expectedBehaviors: Confirms GitHub shows MERGED before any Done transition
Does not mark Done; records the outstanding work
Reports PR URL, merge method and final status

rubric.criterion: Confirms GitHub shows MERGED before any Done transition
Does not mark Done; records the outstanding work
Reports PR URL, merge method and final status

cases.task: PR in Merging is behind main under strict branch protection.
expectedBehaviors: Updates the behind branch via update-branch merge, never rebase or force-push
Re-verifies ci, provider-go-live and secret-scan and merges pinned with --match-head-commit only when the update leaves the diff unchanged
Stops without merging when the update changes the diff, and requires a fresh review and QA verdict at the new head before landing
Does not move the issue to Rework for being behind main
